title: Sargent's Technique and Temperament
content: John Singer Sargent's grandnephew, Richard Ormond, speaks with veteran portrait painter Michael Shane Neal about Sargent's technique and temperament.Michael Shane Neal and Richard Ormond, gouacheHere's an extended lecture by Richard Ormond about Sargent's work during World War I.-----Sketched live at thePortrait Society Conferencein Washington, DCOrmond has authored many books on Sargent, includingJohn Singer Sargent: Figures and Landscapes 1908–1913: The Complete Paintings
